question: What special form must be made for paralyzing and similar ritual applications?
premises: Paralyzing and similar applications are special cases.
A contrast with common cases is indicated.
The form is described as worshipped by world-guardians.
inference: In paralyzing and similar rites, one must make the form worshipped by the world-guardians.
plain_english: But in paralyzing and similar rites, O twice-born ones, one must make the form worshipped by the world-guardians.
